description: Fine-grained Solemn Mass priest/deacon/subdeacon/acolyte/thurifer movements, with Requiem branch gates. English Ritus source checked; Offertory VII.9/XIII.1 Latin wording crosschecked against a Latin transcription, including correction of English translation actor omission. Original printed 1962 Latin facsimile and independent event timing remain pending.

offertoryLatinCrosscheck.editorialFinding: Latin VII.9 says Subdiaconus infundit paululum aquae in Calicem; Diaconus illum Celebranti dat, et pedem Calicis tangens. The cited English rendering skips the subdeacon water pour and assigns the succeeding chalice handoff/support clause to the wrong minister. XIII.1 omits the water blessing, not the Deus qui humanae prayer or the subdeacon's physical pouring.
offertoryLatinCrosscheck.limit: Research correction only. NOT proof of live movement, event clock or final facsimile certification.

events.reviewNote: Ritus VII.9 specifies wine poured before the water blessing prayer Deus qui humanae at C0112, not during the prayer.

events.shortRubricFr: Présente l'eau au célébrant en disant Benedicite, Pater reverende.
events.reviewNote: Latin VII.9 assigns presentation of the cruet and Benedicite to the subdeacon in ordinary Solemn Mass. XIII.1 omits blessing of the water in Requiem; it does not cancel the subdeacon's physical water-pour. Whether the verbal Benedicite is retained in Solemn Requiem is not separately certified, so this combined speech record remains NOT_REQUIEM and must not be projected as an active Requiem formula.

events.sourceCueText: Deus, qui humánæ substántiæ dignitátem mirabíliter condidísti, et mirabílius reformásti:
events.reviewNote: XIII.1 removes the priest's blessing, not the prayer. Under VII.9, the SUBDEACON pours the water in Solemn Mass; PRIEST is the correct actor only for the omitted blessing in this negative-action record. See distinct research-only water-pour MR62.SOL.B02.068. No observed or timed priest movement is implied.

events.reviewNote: Latin VII.9 explicitly says Subdiaconus infundit paululum aquae in Calicem. Applies in ordinary Solemn and Solemn Requiem; XIII.1 only suppresses the priest blessing. Not covered by B02.018 (water presented and spoken Benedicite, held in Requiem). The original Latin printed-facsimile authority and an independent non-text event owner/clock remain held; text position cannot observe the pour.
